- The reaction of **chlorine **with **dilute alkali** is an example of a disproportionation reaction
- In these reactions, the chlorine gets oxidised and reduced at the same time

blocks.label: Exam Hint
blocks.md: Adding chlorine to a water supply is an effective way to make the water safe to drink as it forms the sterilising agent HClO which in turn dissociates in water into another sterilising agent, ClO<sup>– </sup>(aq)
